label: Every maximum in being outside the reduced nominal description is GOD_2
paraphrase: Difference statement, analyst formulation: every being maximal in being (MAXIME_ENS_1) either meets the reduced nominal description (it causes the being of every other being, CausesAllInGenus at esse, and is the only maximum in being) or is GOD_2. Stated as a disjunction so that no decidability is assumed; classically, every maximum in being outside the reduced description is GOD_2. It says nothing about maxima that meet the description. Open; not attributed to a source.
